name: GridDropSavedCaches

name: GridSaveRuntime
plate_comment: Saves manager slot index11 (runtime grid) to caller-supplied one-word string slot. Opens output mode0x10 and calls GridWriteV2. 0x12dd2-0x12de0 captures success from stream state &5 BEFORE std::filebuf::close; 0x12dbc returns captured bool in r0. Close return ignored. No temporary rename/fsync in this function, unlike separate persistence writer. Does not select a native flag or invalidate saved caches; caller is boundary 0x92e0, not recovered wholesale.

name: GridLoadFile
plate_comment: Opens caller-selected string filename in mode8, invokes GridReadDispatch, returns bool captured from stream state &5 before closing; close result ignored. Header/scale/MD5 mismatch may leave stream good, so return !=0 is not proof of format acceptance. Does not select a native flag. No original std::string type inferred.

name: FUN_0001718c

A distinct saved-grid branch drops flags1..11 at0x175b8, reads selected flag from unknown owner state+0x15b0 then record+4, calls GridGetSavedBuffer at0x175cc, copies selected grid or fallback, and drops caches again at0x17646. State/transform/algorithm semantics and unknown owner offsets intentionally not recovered. name: GridResetCells
plate_comment: Re-centers full bounds preserving dimensions via 0x21dc0; zeroes active view at metadata+0x10; fills bounds.width*bounds.height target bytes with *fill. Invoked only after v2 digest comparison passes. No allocation/resize/bounds check here.

name: GridWriteV2
plate_comment: RRSLAM v2 stream writer. 0x1abc0-0x1abde writes 10-byte RRSLAM/version=2/header-length=20 prefix; 0x1ac00-0x1ac78 writes five LE words: scale=20,left,top,width,height. GridDiskHeaderV2 is byte-aligned disk documentation ONLY, never an in-memory grid cast. Extracts active view from metadata+0x10 into row-major byte buffer; initializes to 0x80, copies rows using full bounds stride. Product is low 32 bits of width*height; width loop is signed >0, row limit unsigned. 0x1ad0a-0x1ad38 writes cells then 16-byte MD5 of cells only. Skips later stages on stream state bit 1 (badbit), not failbit. Does not rename, fsync, or select a filename. Returns stream pointer; does not establish durability. Zero product uses NULL buffer and helper emits zero digest, not MD5(empty). Occupancy probability mapping unresolved.

name: GridGetBuffer
signature: GridBufferRef * GridGetBuffer(GridBufferRef * out, void * store, int * index, uchar * fill)
plate_comment: Gets/creates pointer-table slot indexed directly by *index, NOT a native flag. Existing cells return valid=1 immediately. Missing slot: 1024x1024 allocation (0x100000 bytes), centered bounds via 0x21dc0, fill every cell from *fill, metadata stride36. Allocation failure sets only out->valid=0; other result fields are not established. No lock in this routine. ABI-level explicit result pointer, not invented original C++ return signature.

name: GridReadV2
plate_comment: V2 body; dispatcher has already consumed 10 bytes. Reads 20-byte view block: scale,left,top,width,height. Requires scale==20 at 0x1d29c; computes low-32-bit width*height at 0x1d2ba with no explicit dimension/bounds/overflow validation. Reads byte cells and 16-byte digest. All four words must compare at 0x1d324/0x1d33e/0x1d346/0x1d34e before mutation. Digest excludes entire header. Success resets full existing target to 0x80, merges file rectangle into active view, copies rows using target bounds and stride. Width copy condition signed >0; height iteration unsigned. Scale or MD5 rejection returns same stream without explicit setstate; outer stream-state success does NOT prove cells accepted. Intermediate checks test only state bit 1 (badbit), not failbit. No trailing-length or occupancy-value validation. No lock in this function; caller synchronization unresolved.

name: GridReadDispatch
plate_comment: Reads 10-byte prefix. Magic checks 0x1d488-0x1d4a6 compare RRSLAM (0x4c535252,0x4d41). Matching magic: version 2 requires uint16 header-length 20 then GridReadV2; version 1 requires 36 then legacy 0x1cf60. Unknown version/header length returns without setstate. Magic mismatch calls legacy 0x1ca54 after prefix read; legacy seek/format behavior not recovered here. Returns stream pointer, not format-validation status. Tests bit 1 only internally.

name: GridGetSavedBuffer
signature: GridBufferRef * GridGetSavedBuffer(GridBufferRef * out, void * store, int * flag)
plate_comment: Storage cache loader: index=*flag+11. Existing pointer bypasses file read, returns GridGetBuffer result. Otherwise obtains 1024x1024 buffer filled 0x80, copies GridFilenameSlot string and opens input mode 8. Calls GridReadDispatch, accepts if stream state &5 ==0. On allocation/open/stream failure drops same cache slot with base11 and sets out->valid=0. Header/scale/digest mismatch need not set stream state: can return valid=1 with initialized unchanged cells and retain cache. No lock around cache lookup/load/drop observed; dmb/ldrex/strex belong to string reference count, not cache synchronization. Close result is ignored. ABI explicit out pointer; original C++ class/layout unknown.

name: GridCellDigest
signature: void GridCellDigest(uchar * cells, uint length, uchar * digest)
plate_comment: 16-byte MD5-compatible helper for ordinary grids (<2^29 bytes): standard IV at0x3f434, 64-byte blocks, 0x80 padding and four output words. Bit-length low word is length<<3 and high word is forced zero; do not generalize to enormous inputs. Callers hash only width*height cell bytes, never header. NULL digest exits; NULL cells yields sixteen zero bytes, even for length0 (not standard MD5(empty)). Saved-file hashes verified with hashlib; helper/internal compression is not firmware-executed.
